Second pre-release of 2.1 — **removing advert text** and a fix found on Windows.

## New

- **Remove advert text** (*Edit > Remove advert text …* for all books, or right-click a book in the library): finds lines like "OceanofPDF.com" and shows every place with the text around it. If the text sits in a container of its own (a div or paragraph), the container goes too, so no empty line stays behind; otherwise only the text is removed. Untick what should stay. The books are written right away, with a backup first.
- Patterns under *Settings > Books > Advert text*: one per line, OceanofPDF.com by default, `/…/` for a regular expression.

## Fixed

- **Metadata suggestions** (Series, Authors, Publisher, Language, Tags, own text columns): once the suggestion list had opened, typing stopped until something was picked from the list. Typing now goes on as normal while the list is open. The bug was there since 2.0.

## Install

- **Linux:** *Help > Check for updates* in an installed copy (with *Settings > Updates > Include pre-releases* on), or `install.sh` from this repository.
- **Windows:** `Bookbench_Setup_2.1-beta2.exe` (not signed yet: SmartScreen > *More info* > *Run anyway*).
